test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 15 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Find the simple interest (in ₹) on ₹2000 as a sum borrowed at 9% per year rate of interest for 5 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹2000

Rate (R) = 9% per year

Time (T) = 5 years

**Formula used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = dfrac{P times R times T}{100} 

**Calculation:**

SI = dfrac{2000 times 9 times 5}{100} 

⇒ SI = dfrac{90000}{100} 

⇒ SI = ₹900

**∴ The correct answer is option 1.**
